title: Concept: A declared name is one edit away from `importlib-metadata`
description: Pipfile declares a declared requirement name in Pipfile within one edit of `importlib-metadata`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Pip resolves these names against the configured index, so a name that only looks like the intended project delivers whatever that other project publishes. The name this rule expects is `importlib-metadata`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Pipfile (pypi).
risk: Pip resolves these names against the configured index, so a name that only looks like the intended project delivers whatever that other project publishes. The name this rule expects is `importlib-metadata`.
